items.title: Jake Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: a guy named Parker, Colonel Dave Parker, a real bad apple.

ctx.x: The best, yeah, the best. The King of Swing. A real King of Swing. I’ll tell you, he was really something. Yeah I liked him because he was like a salmon, you know, like Buddy Rich, he swam upstream. Everything was coming against him and the press was one hundred percent against him. Not the press, but a guy named Parker, Colonel Dave Parker, a real bad apple. And Ted just frumped them all, and one and one, and beat them all down, yeah. Just single handed. You know, fantastic. They pulled a shift on him, you know,…
